title: TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency
abstract: arXiv:2610.17540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Textual reasoning before acting has improved vision-language-action (VLA) models, but at the cost of latency: every action conditioned on the reasoning text must wait for autoregressive decoding. We show that actions do not need to wait for or condition on the generated reasoning to benefit from it, because the reasoning supervision already improves the backbone representation. We introduce TacitVLA, a reasoning VLA whose action expert never attends to the reasoning it generates for the current call. On long-horizon tasks where the reasoning text also serves as episodic memory, it can generate each entry during action execution rather than before acting. We evaluate it in a controlled study on four benchmarks spanning manipulation and autonomous driving, memory and non-memory tasks: RoboMME, RMBench, LIBERO, and PhysicalAI-AV. On all four, TacitVLA matches the performance of its explicit-reasoning counterpart at up to 3.4x lower latency,

translated_title: TacitVLA：无推理延迟的推理型视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 在行动前进行文本推理已经提升了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的性能，但代价是延迟：每个以推理文本为条件的动作都必须等待自回归解码完成。我们证明，动作并不需要等待或依赖于生成的推理内容才能从中受益，因为推理监督本身已经改进了骨干网络的表征能力。我们提出了TacitVLA，一种推理型VLA模型，其动作专家从不关注当前调用中生成的推理内容。在长时程任务中，当推理文本同时充当情景记忆时，模型可以在动作执行过程中生成每条记忆条目，而不是在行动之前。我们在涵盖操作与自动驾驶、记忆与非记忆任务的四个基准上进行了对照评估：RoboMME、RMBench、LIBERO和PhysicalAI-AV。在全部四个基准上，TacitVLA在延迟降低至多3.4倍的情况下，达到了与其显式推理对应模型相同的性能。
tldr: TacitVLA让动作专家不再依赖当前生成的推理文本，仅通过推理监督改进骨干表征，就能在保持显式推理模型性能的同时将延迟降低至多3.4倍。
en_tdlr: TacitVLA achieves the performance of explicit-reasoning VLA models at up to 3.4x lower latency by showing that actions benefit from reasoning supervision through improved backbone representations, without needing to condition on the generated reasoning text.
